senses.definition: (Judaism) A weeklong period of formal mourning for a close relative.
examples:
Seymour: Audrey, quick! We've got to do an emergency [flower] arrangement.
[…]
Mr. Mushnik: The Shivas are our most important funereal account. A big, enormous family, they're dropping off like flies!

quotes.text: Did you know that some parents sit shiva […] for 30 days if their child is discovered to be gay?
quotes.reference: 1974 February 2, “Jewish Gay Group”, in Gay Community News, volume 1, number 32, page 2:

quotes.text: “Mo Kellman lost his wife ten years ago.” “Does that mean the shiva is over?”
